name: add_comm_nat
statement: theorem add_comm_nat (a b : ℕ) : a + b = b + a

name: prime_101
statement: theorem prime_101 : Nat.Prime 101

name: sq_shift_nonneg
statement: theorem sq_shift_nonneg (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ x ^ 2 - 2 * x + 1

name: two_mul_le_sq_add_sq
statement: theorem two_mul_le_sq_add_sq (a b : ℝ) : 2 * a * b ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2

name: abs_triangle
statement: theorem abs_triangle (a b : ℝ) : |a + b| ≤ |a| + |b|

name: x_add_inv_ge_two
statement: theorem x_add_inv_ge_two (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) : 2 ≤ x + 1 / x

name: sum_sq_ge_sum_prod
statement: theorem sum_sq_ge_sum_prod (a b c : ℝ) : a * b + b * c + c * a ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2

name: nat_sq_mod_four
statement: theorem nat_sq_mod_four (n : ℕ) : n ^ 2 % 4 = 0 ∨ n ^ 2 % 4 = 1

name: three_dvd_cube_sub
statement: theorem three_dvd_cube_sub (n : ℤ) : 3 ∣ n ^ 3 - n

name: six_dvd_consecutive
statement: theorem six_dvd_consecutive (n : ℕ) : 6 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2)

name: sum_odd_eq_sq
statement: theorem sum_odd_eq_sq (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (2 * i + 1) = n ^ 2

name: gauss_sum
statement: theorem gauss_sum (n : ℕ) : 2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), i = n * (n + 1)

name: cauchy_schwarz_two
statement: theorem cauchy_schwarz_two (a b c d : ℝ) : (a * c + b * d) ^ 2 ≤ (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * (c ^ 2 + d ^ 2)

name: add_one_le_exp'
statement: theorem add_one_le_exp' (x : ℝ) : x + 1 ≤ Real.exp x

name: sqrt_two_irrational
statement: theorem sqrt_two_irrational : Irrational (Real.sqrt 2)

name: infinitely_many_primes
statement: theorem infinitely_many_primes (n : ℕ) : ∃ p, n ≤ p ∧ Nat.Prime p

name: sum_two_sq_mod_four
statement: theorem sum_two_sq_mod_four (a b : ℤ) : (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) % 4 ≠ 3

name: fib_lt_two_pow
statement: theorem fib_lt_two_pow (n : ℕ) : Nat.fib n < 2 ^ n

name: amgm_three
statement: theorem amgm_three (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c) : 27 * (a * b * c) ≤ (a + b + c) ^ 3

name: fermat_little_seven
statement: theorem fermat_little_seven (a : ℤ) : 7 ∣ a ^ 7 - a

name: sum_cubes
statement: theorem sum_cubes (n : ℕ) : 4 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), i ^ 3 = (n * (n + 1)) ^ 2

name: bernoulli_ineq
statement: theorem bernoulli_ineq (x : ℝ) (hx : -1 ≤ x) (n : ℕ) : 1 + n * x ≤ (1 + x) ^ n
